serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Here we are!
You: This place is huge and it’s relatively close.
Bot: Great find, I know. 
You: Don’t be so smug about it, your track record for good dates is still horrible.
Bot: I just had a rough start, that’s all. 
Bot: When I get a hang on it, you won’t even be able to compete!
You: I didn’t know we were competing, who’s keeping the score?
Bot: I do. You are 27 points ahead, but with this date I will probably close up the gap by 20 points!
You: Wha- 
You: Wait a minute, how exactly are you rating these dates? What’s your method?
Bot: I just measure the average enjoyment during the date by probing your serotonin level before and after it! 
You: That’s…
I feel like it's hopeless to argue with her about it, so I will just let it go.
You: That probing you do, it’s not too invasive, right?
Bot: Well, there’s that CSF thingy and…{{wi}} You don’t need to worry about it, it’s nothing bad!
You: …
At least when my brain turns to mush I will know what caused it…
Bot: It was fun talking, but let’s get to racing! I want to see who’s the better driver!
You: It’s good to see you so eager for this, let’s go!
